name: Minera
description: A GPU launchpad for mining. Rigs earn for verified GPU work from a one-way Burn Pool, guarded by Sentinel against bots, scripts and fake GPUs.
description_good_justification: The website https://mineragpu.tech and the README state what Minera does: a GPU launchpad for mining where rigs earn for verified GPU work from a one-way Burn Pool.
interact_justification: The README links to the website, the docs and the release (obtain), issue forms for bugs and feature requests (feedback) and CONTRIBUTING.md (contribute): https://github.com/mineragpu/minera
contribution_justification: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains the process: fork, branch from main, signed commits with tests, the checks CI runs, and a pull request reviewed by a maintainer.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the requirements: conventional commits, signed commits, a testing policy, passing typecheck, tests and build, no secrets, and updated docs. https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: Overview, quickstart, deploy guide and concepts at https://mineragpu.tech/docs, sources in https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/tree/main/docs
documentation_interface_justification: The coordinator API (https://mineragpu.tech/docs/api), the node protocol (https://mineragpu.tech/docs/node-protocol) and the contracts' functions, events and errors (https://mineragpu.tech/docs/contracts) are documented with inputs and outputs.
sites_https_justification: The website, the API (https://api.mineragpu.tech) and the repository are served only over HTTPS with TLS.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client needed. https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/issues
english_justification: All documentation, code, issues and reviews are in English.
maintained_justification: Active development with daily commits; see https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/commits/main and the v0.1.0 release.
repo_track_justification: Git records every change with author, date and message; commits since October 2026 are signed and Verified.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is committed to the public repository between releases, not only final releases.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version; the first is 0.1.0, tagged v0.1.0.
version_tags_justification: Each release is a signed git tag, e.g. https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/releases/tag/v0.1.0
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/releases/tag/v0.1.0 summarize additions, security changes and upgrade impact; they are written by hand, not a git log.
release_notes_vulns_justification: The 0.1.0 notes identify the one publicly known vulnerability fixed, GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq in the uuid dependency.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through the GitHub issue forms: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/issues/new/choose
report_responses_justification: All bug reports received so far have been acknowledged; SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md set response expectations.
enhancement_responses_justification: Feature requests use the issue form and are answered in the issue.
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues are public and searchable: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/blob/main/SECURITY.md describes how to report a vulnerability, what to include and what to expect.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled on the repository: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/security/advisories/new, as described in SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a report within 3 business days and a status within 7 days.
build_justification: `npm ci` then `npm run build` builds every workspace; Foundry builds the contracts. Docker files in https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/tree/main/ops build the deployed services.
build_common_tools_justification: npm, TypeScript, Vite, Foundry and Docker.
test_justification: Automated suites with `node --test` (shared, coordinator, node client) and Foundry (contracts), released in the repository under Apache-2.0. CONTRIBUTING.md documents how to run them.
test_invocation_justification: `npm test`, and `forge test` for the contracts.
test_most_justification: The suites cover the store contract on memory and Postgres, every route, the job flow, every Sentinel gate, settlement planning and the contracts, plus property tests on money paths and Sentinel.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs typecheck, tests, build and contract tests on every push and pull request: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/actions/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, section "Testing policy": new functionality comes with tests, fixes come with a failing test, security rules are tested.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent major changes added tests with them, e.g. Sentinel (sentinel.test.ts, properties.test.ts), SQL safety (sqlSafety.test.ts) and input validation (node.test.ts).
tests_documented_added_justification: The testing policy and the pull request checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md require tests.
warnings_justification: TypeScript runs in strict mode with exactOptionalPropertyTypes and noImplicitOverride; the Solidity compiler and `forge fmt --check` run in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: Typecheck must pass with no errors in CI before a change lands.
warnings_strict_justification: Strict TypeScript settings throughout; the CI fails on any type error.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer designed the security model: signed node requests with nonces, a one-way pool with a release limit and guardian veto, Sentinel's five gates, parameterized SQL, and least-privilege CI. See https://mineragpu.tech/docs/security and https://mineragpu.tech/docs/sentinel
know_common_errors_justification: Injection: every query is parameterized and enforced by a test. Input validation: strict schemas on every route. Replay: one-time nonces. Sybil and collusion: Sentinel. Secrets: redacted in logs, secret scanning on the repo. Reentrancy and access control in contracts: no withdraw function, role checks, Foundry tests.
crypto_published_justification: Only published algorithms: secp256k1 ECDSA and Keccak-256 (via viem and noble libraries) for signatures and hashes, HMAC-SHA-256 for network digests, TLS for transport.
crypto_call_justification: No cryptography is implemented here; it calls viem, the noble libraries and Node.js crypto.
crypto_floss_justification: All cryptographic libraries used are FLOSS.
crypto_keylength_justification: 256-bit secp256k1 keys and 256-bit hashes; no configuration allows shorter keys.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No SHA-1, MD5 or CBC-mode dependency in the security mechanisms.
crypto_pfs_justification: The software does not implement a key agreement protocol; transport security is TLS provided by the hosting platform.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software does not store passwords; nodes authenticate with signatures from their node key.
crypto_random_justification: Node keys come from viem's generatePrivateKey, request nonces and identifiers from Node.js crypto (randomBytes, randomInt, randomUUID), all cryptographically secure.
delivery_mitm_justification: Code is delivered over HTTPS from GitHub and npm, and the site and API only over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP; dependencies are verified by the npm lockfile integrity hashes over HTTPS, and base images are pinned by digest.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: `npm audit` reports no vulnerabilities and Dependabot alerts are enabled; the last known one (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq) was fixed in 0.1.0.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability is open; SECURITY.md commits to fast fixes.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No valid credentials are in the repository; secret scanning with push protection is enabled.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL with the security-extended query suite runs on every push, pull request and weekly: https://github.com/mineragpu/minera/actions/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security-extended suite targets common vulnerabilities such as injection and unsafe data flows.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: There are no open medium or higher CodeQL findings; findings are fixed before release.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every commit to main and every pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based fuzzing with fast-check runs in CI on the reward split, the release limit, the settlement tree and Sentinel (packages/shared/src/properties.test.ts, apps/coordinator/src/sentinel/properties.test.ts).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe languages are used (TypeScript and Solidity).
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The test and fuzz runs use Node.js strict assertions throughout.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: There are no open medium or higher findings from dynamic analysis.
